add.thisHost: This host (local collectors, no SSH for metrics)
add.windowsHint: Needs the Windows OpenSSH Server and the NVIDIA driver (nvidia-smi). Metrics come from PowerShell over SSH; Hermes and Tailnet checks are not available for Windows.

add.localSparkHint: Open links need a LAN IP. DGX Spark has no Wake-on-LAN.
add.sshPortHint: Default port 22. Change it when sshd listens elsewhere.
add.sshKeyHint: SSH runs on the sparkDash host. Docker: mount a key at /root/.ssh/id_ed25519 (or SSH_IDENTITY_FILE). IPs are from that host, not your laptop.
add.sshPasswordHint: Password is encrypted on this server. The host can be offline while it is saved.
add.testHint: Checks SSH, hardware and LLM before you add it. Optional.
add.head: Head
add.nameHint: Shown in the sidebar and on the Overview.
add.workersNoPorts: Workers have no local LLM API, so no ports are probed.
add.monitorComfyHint: Job queue and live progress. Default port 8188.
add.monitorHermesHint: Checks for new releases every 10 min and adds an Update Hermes button.

edit.name: Name
edit.localHostHint: Open links and directed Wake-on-LAN need a LAN IP.
edit.localSparkHint: Open links need a LAN IP. DGX Spark has no Wake-on-LAN.
edit.macDetected: Using enP7s7 automatically ({{mac}}). Leave blank to keep auto, or enter a different MAC.
edit.macUndetected: Leave blank to use enP7s7 once the host has been online and detected.
edit.thisHost: This host (local collectors — no SSH for metrics)
edit.roleHelp: Head always monitors the local LLM. Standalone can opt in or out. Workers hide the LLM card and do not probe ports.
edit.head: Head
edit.llmMonitoringHelp: Enable probing the local LLM API and showing the LLM card.
edit.comfyMonitoringHelp: Enable probing ComfyUI and showing the ComfyUI card.
edit.hermesHelp: Hermes Agent CLI is installed on this machine; enable update monitoring and one-click updates.
edit.hermesDescription: Checks for updates in the background (10 min) and adds an Update Hermes button that runs hermes update on this machine via SSH.
edit.tailnetHelp: Enable reporting this unit's tailnet presence.
edit.workerLabelHelp: Shown on the overview card. Leave blank to show ‘distributed’.
edit.headSparkHelp: Optional. Which Spark serves as the cluster head for this worker.
edit.sshPortHint: Default 22. Use this when sshd listens elsewhere.
edit.sshKeyHint: SSH runs on the sparkDash host. Docker: mount a key at /root/.ssh/id_ed25519 (or SSH_IDENTITY_FILE). IPs are from that host, not your laptop.
edit.passwordRequired: (required — saved even if host is offline)
edit.passwordStored: Password is stored encrypted on this server. Offline Sparks still keep it and reconnect automatically when back up.
edit.passwordSaveHint: Enter once and Save (or Test). Stored encrypted — host does not need to be online.
edit.passwordSavedOffline: Password saved encrypted (works even while host is offline).
edit.passwordRequiredError: Password required for password-auth Sparks (saved encrypted, host can be offline).
edit.passwordFirstError: Enter the SSH password first — it will be saved even if the host is down.

harness.name: Name
harness.newToken: New bearer token (leave blank to keep the saved one)
harness.routesHelp: A route sends one harness to a Spark and port. A directory prefix wins over a general route. Rows with no route stay off the cards.

errors.invalidProtocol: Use an http or https URL
errors.credentials: Remove the username and password from the URL
errors.routePort: Each route needs a port from 1 to 65535

alerts.title: Alert notifications
alerts.invalidWait: The wait must be a number of seconds.
alerts.overviewExceptionsHelp: The conditions the Overview exceptions strip shows.
alerts.healthFindingsHelp: The findings on the unit cards, with the Health rules' own thresholds.
alerts.sendNotificationsHelp: The server watches the Health findings and the Overview exceptions and notifies the channels below when one holds for its wait, and again when it clears. Off by default: while off nothing is evaluated or sent. Saved immediately.
alerts.offNote: Turn notifications on to change what notifies and where.
alerts.channelsHelp: URLs are stored encrypted with the unit passwords and shown masked. They may point at the LAN (a self-hosted ntfy) or the internet, under the same rules as unit and LLM addresses; redirects are not followed.
alerts.noChannels: No channels yet: alerts still show on the Overview strip.
alerts.name: Name
alerts.hiddenUrl: Stored URL is hidden. Leave it to keep it, or paste a new one.
alerts.missingUrl: No URL is stored for this channel. Enter it again.
alerts.remindHelp: Repeat the notification for an alert that has not cleared.
alerts.recentHelp: Fired and cleared since the server started. Every notification sent or failed is also on the Activity page.
